name: Multiverse Comic
tagline: bestagentkits' comic multiverse: Ben-Day halftone, 6 px ink borders, cyan / magenta offset shadows, Anton shouts in yellow, on twos.

motion.direction: bestagentkits comic multiverse, 110 BPM. Anton uppercase headlines in yellow `gold` with a 3 px ink stroke, Bangers labels and SFX words (`stamp` BAM / NOPE), Permanent Marker signature, halftone dots over everything, 6 px ink borders, triple offset shadows (cyan `goldd`, magenta `ter`, ink); RGB misregistration kicked on alternate beats; motion ON TWOS (12 steps/s). `slam` 1.3 → 1 power4.in + shake, headline words flip in staggered, a dot wipe between panels, flash 0.8 + shake on drops. Captions in a yellow box with a 5 px ink border, the current word magenta. Loud, playful, no Marvel names.
